Join us for an annual Halloween Costume Contest! 🎃

📅 Saturday, October 24th
⏰ 12–2 PM
📍 @sunsetsocialphl Social

We’re heading back to Sunset Social for our annual Halloween Meetup! 

Last year’s event worked out perfectly, and based on feedback from so many of you who wanted to go back, we knew we had to return to the same spot again this year!

And of course, we’ll once again have prizes, giveaways, Halloween fun, and LOTS of Shih Tzus in costume! 🥇🥈🥉

Link in bio to RSVP (helps us to prepare for # of people) 

WE COULD USE A LITTLE HELP FROM OUR COMMUNITY THIS YEAR!

As Philly Shih Tzus continues to grow, so do our meetups. If you’d like to help support the group and this year’s Halloween event, even a donation as little as $10 makes a difference and helps with prizes, giveaways, supplies, and the other costs that go into putting our meetups together.

Venmo @jenmaher14 (9144)

More details are coming soon, but for now, MARK YOUR CALENDARS and start planning those costumes! 👻🎃🐾
